deploy.preDeployCommand: python manage.py migrate && python manage.py shell -c "import os; from accounts.models import Role, User; role, _ = Role.objects.get_or_create(code=Role.Code.ADMINISTRATOR, defaults={'name': 'Administrator'}); login = os.environ['ADMIN_LOGIN']; User.objects.filter(login=login).exists() or User.objects.create_superuser(login=login, name=os.environ['ADMIN_NAME'], role=role, password=os.environ['ADMIN_PASSWORD'])"
